Repair of the fault of the signal not appearing

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps for repairing the fault of the turbine safety oil presence indication lamp PS on the Thermal Disk not appearing, although safety oil is actually present.

The document was prepared by Eng. Ayman Mohamed Abdel Meguid, reviewed and tested by Eng. Magdy Mahrous Shehata, endorsed by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras, General Manager of Assiut Thermal Station, approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of Sector, and certified by Mr. Eng. Gamal El-Din Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and MPIS Coordinator for the company.

items: This fault is worked on while the unit is out of service, because working on the switch for the turbine safety oil presence indication lamp PS, located on the main stop valve, causes tripping of the unit's 132 kV breaker

Issue a work order approved by the station operations department; the work is carried out under the supervision of the maintenance engineer executing the work order approved by the head of the instrument maintenance department
Record the occupational safety and health category of all personnel named in the work order

rows: Search in the turbine file 'Turbine Control Supervising (204)a', Chapter 5, 'Turbine Protection', page Max60a, until it is shown that there is an a2-switch on the main stop valve: switch No. (a3325A) on the main stop valve right, and the other No. (a3325B) on the main stop valve left; they are responsible for lighting the P2 preparation indication lamp
Place the addresses of the a2-switches on the computer, namely (B328) and (BF28); it was found that there is an error in the output signal of the BF28 address
Simulate this address, (BF28), and the lamp lit

Upon removing the cover on the main stop valve left, a problem was found in the switch on it: its normal position, with safety oil present, is open on its terminals (110 V DC), but it was found closed
Make sure the switch repair is complete and that it works normally
Re-prepare the PS and make sure the indication lamp appears and the fault is repaired

Introduction
This document sets out the steps for repairing the fault of the turbine safety oil presence indication lamp PS on the Thermal Disk not appearing, although safety oil is actually present.
The document was prepared by Eng. Ayman Mohamed Abdel Meguid, reviewed and tested by Eng. Magdy Mahrous Shehata, endorsed by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras, General Manager of Assiut Thermal Station, approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of Sector, and certified by Mr. Eng. Gamal El-Din Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and MPIS Coordinator for the company.
Safety precautions
This fault is worked on while the unit is out of service, because working on the switch for the turbine safety oil presence indication lamp PS, located on the main stop valve, causes tripping of the unit's 132 kV breaker
Issue a work order approved by the station operations department; the work is carried out under the supervision of the maintenance engineer executing the work order approved by the head of the instrument maintenance department
Record the occupational safety and health category of all personnel named in the work order
Tools and equipment used
Flat screwdriver, 8 inch; pliers, 7 inch
Flat screwdriver, 4 inch; Allen key, 6 inch
Avometer for measurement
Flat screwdriver, 8 inch; pliers, 7 inch
Flat screwdriver, 4 inch; Allen key, 6 inch
Avometer for measurement
Procedures to be carried out
Open the work order | 1.
Search in the turbine file 'Turbine Control Supervising (204)a', Chapter 5, 'Turbine Protection', page Max60a, until it is shown that there is an a2-switch on the main stop valve: switch No. (a3325A) on the main stop valve right, and the other No. (a3325B) on the main stop valve left; they are responsible for lighting the P2 preparation indication lamp | 2.
Place the addresses of the a2-switches on the computer, namely (B328) and (BF28); it was found that there is an error in the output signal of the BF28 address | 3.
Simulate this address, (BF28), and the lamp lit | 4.
Upon removing the cover on the main stop valve left, a problem was found in the switch on it: its normal position, with safety oil present, is open on its terminals (110 V DC), but it was found closed | 5.
Make sure the switch repair is complete and that it works normally | 6.
Re-prepare the PS and make sure the indication lamp appears and the fault is repaired | 7.
